entries.name: Combat Reflexes
entries.notes: +1 to all active defenses, +6 to recover from stun, never freeze in surprise

entries.name: Danger Sense
entries.notes: GM warns of threats just before they strike (surprise is negated)

entries.name: Hard to Kill
entries.notes: +1/level to HT rolls to avoid death; can take 1–5 levels

entries.name: Hard to Subdue
entries.notes: +1/level to remain conscious when reduced to 0 or negative HP

entries.name: High Pain Threshold
entries.notes: Ignore shock penalties from injury; +3 on HT rolls to avoid knockdown

entries.name: Lifting ST
entries.notes: Extra ST only for lifting/carrying purposes; does not affect damage

entries.name: Charisma
entries.notes: +1/level to Influence skills (Leadership, Panhandling, Public Speaking, Savoir-Faire, Sex Appeal, Streetwise); NPCs are predisposed to trust and listen to you [max 4 levels]

entries.name: Contact
entries.notes: Reliable source of information or aid (varies by skill and frequency)

entries.name: Church Organisation Informant
entries.notes: A representative of a church enforcement body (Nighthawks, Mandated Punishers, Machinery Hivemind, etc.) has chosen you as an informant. Receive help from authorities when in minor legal trouble or when caught using Beyonder powers without harm to innocents. Earn contribution points for important information or assistance, exchangeable for money or Beyonder formulas/ingredients. 5 pts: newly recruited, must prove your worth. 10–15 pts: trusted informant; the organisation's representative trusts your judgement.

entries.name: Official Beyonder
entries.notes: You operate under the sanction of a recognised church or organisation. Benefits: Spirit Vision (see Chapter 4: Universal Beyonder Ability — Spirit Vision), Revolver +2, Ritualistic Magic +1, Hidden Lore (Beyonders) +3, Occultism +2, Hermes Language (Broken). You hold Legal Enforcement Powers as a sanctioned investigator. Drawback: Duty (to your organisation) — you can be called upon for assignments and must follow institutional protocol.

entries.name: Eidetic Memory
entries.notes: +5 to remember things after one reading; near-perfect recall

entries.name: Empathy
entries.notes: +3 to social skill rolls

entries.name: Language Talent
entries.notes: All language skills cost half the normal points

entries.name: Reputation
entries.notes: Known for something specific — positive reactions from relevant groups

entries.name: Voice
entries.notes: +2 to all rolls to influence others through speech

entries.name: Alertness
entries.notes: +1 per level to all Per rolls. Notice more of your surroundings — active and passive perception both benefit.

entries.name: Healer
entries.notes: +2 to all rolls to diagnose, treat, and heal; +3 to First Aid specifically; HT rolls to avoid or recover from disease at +2.

entries.name: Single-Minded
entries.notes: +3 to any extended concentration task (research, crafting, lockpicking, etc.) when you can focus without interruption.

entries.name: Versatile
entries.notes: +1 to defaults skill rolls — any time you use a skill at default, you are effectively one level better.

entries.name: Intuition
entries.notes: Once per session, the GM may give you a meaningful hunch about a decision. Ask the GM: 'Is this a good/bad idea?' The GM must answer honestly.

entries.name: Lightning Calculator
entries.notes: Numerical puzzles and mental maths at +2.

entries.name: Absolute Direction
entries.notes: Always know which way is north; never become lost in natural terrain. +3 to Navigation and Body Sense rolls.

entries.name: Language (specify)
entries.notes: Individual language proficiency. See the Languages section for cost tables based on proficiency (Native/Accented/Broken) and type (Common vs Mystical).

entries.name: Acute Social Awareness
entries.notes: +2 to all Body Language and Detect Lies rolls. You read a room before you enter it.

entries.name: Class Mobility
entries.notes: Move believably across two social classes. +2 to Savoir-Faire in either; NPCs rarely question your presence.

entries.name: Connections: Church Lay Staff
entries.notes: Recognized civilian assistant to one Orthodox Church. Access to facilities; some protection from routine Nighthawk scrutiny.

entries.name: Connections: Press Credentials
entries.notes: Recognized press identity. Opens doors otherwise closed; plausible reason to be anywhere in a city.

entries.name: Fearsome Reputation
entries.notes: Known in criminal circles. Relevant NPCs start cautious; Intimidation in these circles is at +2.

entries.name: Falsified Identity
entries.notes: A fully documented second identity in official records, distinct from your real one. Holds under regular police scrutiny and superficial investigation; fails if an investigator or official Beyonder peers deeper. Requires arranging papers (see Hired Allies & Services).

entries.name: Local Legend
entries.notes: Well-known in one neighbourhood (specify). +2 to social rolls there; people look out for you.

entries.name: Mentor
entries.notes: Senior figure offers intermittent guidance. Once per session consult for info, a contact, or a skill roll at their level.

entries.name: Multilingual
entries.notes: Fluent in two additional languages. No penalty to language-dependent social skills in those languages.

entries.name: Natural Leader
entries.notes: When you issue a direct command under pressure, allies may reroll their first Fright Check or morale roll with +1. Once per scene.

entries.name: Police Informant
entries.notes: Arrangement with local constabulary. Minor legal trouble can often be redirected. Discreet — exposure would be dangerous.

entries.name: Respectable Address
entries.notes: Lodgings in a creditable neighbourhood. +1 to social rolls with middle/upper class NPCs who would otherwise look down on you.

entries.name: Street Credibility
entries.notes: Trusted in the working-class underground. Call in small favours from dock workers, factory hands, and street operators once per session.

entries.name: Fearlessness
entries.notes: +1 per level to Fright Checks; also grants immunity to intimidation from beings with fewer levels of Fearlessness than you. Vital in a world of horrors.

entries.name: Fit
entries.notes: +1 to all HT rolls; Allows you to Burn FP during combat.

entries.name: Very Fit
entries.notes: +2 to all HT rolls; recover FP at twice the normal rate. Prerequisite: Fit. Allows you to Burn FP during combat and out of combat.

entries.name: Wealth: Comfortable
entries.notes: Good income; start with £5. Status 1 — those impressed by wealth treat you better (GM discretion).

entries.name: Hunting License
entries.notes: Legal in Loen for hunting rifle only. Costs £5 to obtain in-game. Valid in rural/suburban areas — carrying in city limits draws police attention.

entries.name: General Weapon Certificate
entries.notes: Full civilian firearm permit. Costs £50 to obtain in-game. Allows carry of any non-military weapon in cities; required for pistols, rifles, shotguns in urban areas.

entries.name: Legal Enforcement Powers
entries.notes: Official authority to investigate, detain, and carry weapons in the line of duty. Works within jurisdiction only; may vary by city or organization.

entries.name: Black Market Access
entries.notes: Reliable source for illegal or restricted goods. Once per session attempt to acquire a specific item outside legal channels.

entries.name: Experienced Investigator
entries.notes: Once per investigation scene ask the GM one yes/no question about observable evidence without a skill roll.

entries.name: Former Military Officer
entries.notes: Leadership and Tactics at +1; military contacts; entitled to officer courtesies in formal settings.

entries.name: Industrial Expertise
entries.notes: Deep familiarity with a specific industry (specify). +2 to all relevant skill rolls; NPCs in that industry trust your knowledge.

entries.name: Medical Training (Informal)
entries.notes: Use Physician at IQ-2 without purchasing the skill; First Aid rolls gain +1.

entries.name: Navigator's Eye
entries.notes: Never become lost in any city previously visited; rural navigation rolls at +2.

entries.name: Photographic Instinct
entries.notes: Photography rolls at +2; instinctively know what to capture as evidence.

entries.name: Safecracker
entries.notes: +3 to Lockpicking for combination locks and mechanical safes specifically.

entries.name: Underworld Lawyer
entries.notes: Once per session cite an obscure legal technicality convincingly enough to delay, redirect, or dismiss a legal problem.

entries.name: Alcohol Tolerance
entries.notes: Never suffer social penalties from moderate drinking; Carousing rolls to appear sober at +3.

entries.name: Cold Resistance
entries.notes: No penalties from cold weather up to freezing; hypothermia rolls at +2.

entries.name: Controlled Breathing
entries.notes: Hold breath for HT × 3 seconds without a roll; HT rolls to resist airborne toxins at +2.

entries.name: Fast Healer
entries.notes: Recover 1 additional HP per day of rest. Injuries that would leave others bedridden leave you functional in half the time.

entries.name: Hard Stomach
entries.notes: No HT rolls required for disgusting environments — gore, corpses, foul conditions.

entries.name: Iron Jaw
entries.notes: Knockdown rolls from blows to the head at +2; never bite through your own tongue under shock.

entries.name: Light Sleeper
entries.notes: Perception rolls while sleeping at +4; never caught completely unaware at night.

entries.name: Low-Profile Build
entries.notes: Physical appearance is unremarkable. All attempts to identify you from description are at -2.

entries.name: Night Eyes
entries.notes: Reduce all darkness penalties by 2; in dim gaslight or moonlight suffer no penalty at all.

entries.name: Perfect Balance
entries.notes: +6 to avoid knockdown; +2 to Acrobatics, Climbing, Piloting

entries.name: Great Balance
entries.notes: +2 to avoid knockdown; +1 to Acrobatics, Climbing, Piloting

entries.name: Rapid Recovery
entries.notes: Stun durations halved; recover from knockdown in half normal time.

entries.name: Flexibility
entries.notes: +3 to Climbing and Escape; ignore up to -3 close-quarters penalties.

entries.name: Double-Jointed
entries.notes: +5 to Climbing and Escape; ignore up to -5 close-quarters penalties for wrestling or grappling; any body part bends any way.

entries.name: Acute Vision
entries.notes: +2 to Vision rolls; notice details at a distance, read lips, spot hidden objects.

entries.name: Incisive Vision
entries.notes: Prerequisite: Acute Vision. +4 to all Vision rolls.

entries.name: Acute Hearing
entries.notes: +2 to Hearing rolls; detect faint sounds, eavesdrop through walls, identify speech in noise.

entries.name: Resistant (specify)
entries.notes: HT rolls to resist a specific category at +3 (3 pts) or +8 (5 pts). Common choices: Disease, Poison, Temperature Extremes.

entries.name: Outdoorsman
entries.notes: +1 per level to all Outdoor skills (Camouflage, Fishing, Naturalist, Navigation, Survival, Tracking, Weather Sense). Max 4 levels.

entries.name: Aura Sensitivity
entries.notes: Sense the emotional weight of places. In locations where violence, grief, or supernatural events occurred, receive a vague impression without rolling.

entries.name: Death Sense
entries.notes: Passive awareness of recent death within 30 meters (within 24 hours). Sense its direction without rolling; can sense whether a person is dying.

entries.name: Divine Touchstone
entries.notes: An Orthodox deity has taken minor notice of you. Once per session ask the GM a yes/no question your character senses as an impression.

entries.name: Dreamsight
entries.notes: Dreams contain genuine information. Once per session the GM may offer a cryptic dream-image related to current events; sharing it grants +1 to one investigation roll.

entries.name: Ether Body Awareness
entries.notes: Know immediately when a supernatural effect is targeting your soul, not just your body — even without Spirit Vision.

entries.name: Fate Sensitivity
entries.notes: Once per session when making a decision with major consequences, ask the GM: 'Does this feel wrong?' The GM must answer honestly.

entries.name: Ghost Proximity Sense
entries.notes: Passive. Sense when a spirit is within 10 meters — a cold certainty. No details; no roll required.

entries.name: Pathway Resonance
entries.notes: Unexplained affinity with one specific Pathway (specify). +3 to rolls to identify items, individuals, or rituals associated with it.

entries.name: Ritual Intuition
entries.notes: Sense when a ritual is being performed within 50 meters. Notice the spiritual disturbance without rolling — even without knowing its type.

entries.name: Soul Reading (Untrained)
entries.notes: Once per scene the GM may offer one true impression about a target's emotional condition or hidden motive. Cannot be triggered deliberately.

entries.name: Spirit Vision
entries.notes: See the non-physical aspects of beings — Ether Body (health), Spirit Body (emotions), and auras — as well as ghosts and spirits. Activate by expending 1 SPI (see Chapter 4: The Spirituality (SPI) Attribute). May instead be learned in-game from someone who teaches the technique, provided you have a minimum total of 4 SPI.

entries.name: Anchored Soul
entries.notes: All attempts to alter your mental identity — possession, compulsion, pathway side effects — are at -2 against you.

entries.name: Cleansed Spirit
entries.notes: CoR gained from passive exposure are halved. Active corruption from deliberate acts is unaffected.

entries.name: Cold Iron Tolerance
entries.notes: Unaffected by the mild spiritual discomfort iron causes to sensitive individuals. Rare in those with significant spiritual heritage.

entries.name: Faithful Grounding
entries.notes: Genuine faith acts as an anchor. Fright Checks in church buildings, shrines, or during prayer are at +3.

entries.name: Incorruptible Will
entries.notes: +3 to all Will rolls to resist Beyonder abilities, evil god whispers, and ritual compulsion. Does not apply to mundane social pressure.

entries.name: Spiritual Fortitude
entries.notes: Maximum CoR equal Will + 3 rather than just Will.

entries.name: Warded Dreams
entries.notes: All supernatural attempts to enter, read, or alter your dreams require an additional success by 3 or more to take effect.

entries.name: Luck
entries.notes: 1 reroll per session — may reroll any one failed roll.

entries.name: Beckoning Luck
entries.notes: 2 rerolls per session — reroll any failed roll, usable at any time. If the re-roll also fails there is no additional effect — and fate may balance later.

entries.name: Born Under a Named Star
entries.notes: Seers and Diviners who read your fate always notice something unusual. You register as 'marked' in ways they cannot fully interpret.

entries.name: Mystical Item
entries.notes: A single mystical item you already possess, defined with the GM. Cost scales with power: a minor charm (5 pts), a useful tool (10 pts), or a significant piece of equipment (15 pts). The item should match one of the 22 pathways' domains. If lost or destroyed, rename this advantage to 'Mystical Item (Lost)' — no refund.

entries.name: Charmed Object
entries.notes: One item you own provides +1 to one specific skill when used (specify item and skill). Lost permanently if the item is destroyed.

entries.name: Dead Language Fluency
entries.notes: Read and speak one dead language (Ancient Hermes, Ancient Loen, etc.) without having formally learned it. Origin unexplained.

entries.name: Familiar Presence
entries.notes: Animals and spirits are unusually calm near you. Domestic animals never startle; non-hostile spirits observe rather than act against you.

entries.name: Sequence Knowledge
entries.notes: You know the formula for your next Sequence 8 potion — main ingredients, supplementary ingredients, and basic preparation method. This knowledge arrives instinctively once you reach Sequence 9. It does not grant the ingredients, a pre-prepared potion, or an Acting Method. Covers only the immediate next sequence.

entries.name: Knows the Acting Method
entries.notes: You innately understand the Acting Method for your Pathway. At the end of each session, roll 3d6 — the result is the percentage of digestion progress you gain toward your current potion, in addition to your normal Digestion Gain Per Session.

entries.name: Marked by Ritual
entries.notes: A lasting spiritual imprint (define with GM). Grants +2 to one type of SPI roll but may attract unusual attention.

entries.name: Spirit Tongue
entries.notes: Communicate basic intent to ghosts and lingering spirits without the Language of the Dead ability. Limited to yes/no exchanges.

entries.name: Uncanny Survivor
entries.notes: Once per campaign arc, when you would die on a death roll, succeed automatically instead. The GM decides the cost.

entries.name: Sanctity
entries.notes: Your connection to the divine is unusually clear. +2 to Theology and Religious Ritual; once per session, the GM must answer one factual question about Church doctrine or history honestly.
